svg.text: WAY-15 / Two datums, one inhabited destination
Stonewake (+320 m) to Lumen Tide (-1600 m): vertical difference 1,920 m.
Diagram is schematic: neither slope, horizontal distance nor shaft shape is depicted.
No segment-by-segment descent geometry is invented from endpoint elevations.
Use the existing descent-house plans for staging; local air and pressure govern departure.
